nodes.label: §24.4 The genome — three indices, one lemma, and a zero outside physics
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the hardest available test because the genome supplies an object whose content is contingent — one string of 4^N selected by history rather than forbidden by a law — so if the claim is about indexing and not physics it must say something here without being flattering by construction. Returns four things: three negative and one zero.

nodes.label: The genomic coordinate index costs E = 2,886,684,296
nodes.rationale: (chromosome, position) at GRCh38: |X| = 3,088,269,832 against |R(X)| = 5,974,954,128, E/|X| = 0.9347, 512 of 576 ordered pairs violating join-closure. Chromosome 1 is both first in the labelling and longest in the assembly, so the running maximum is constant and R(X) is the whole ambient box: you have to be told where chromosome 21 stops.

nodes.label: R does not repair here — it fabricates
nodes.rationale: Lambda's facets are two-variable monotone bounds so R is the identity on them; the genome's bounds are empirical and non-monotone so R replaces each with a running maximum. On a four-element toy [10,7,13,4] becomes [10,10,13,13] at E = 12 — a closed object describing a different genome, certified with E = 0. P22's forgery arriving without a forger: a zero must state the orientation of its axes or it states nothing. Register 275 extended.

nodes.label: The monotonicity lemma for function graphs
nodes.rationale: For X = {(i, v_i)}, E(X) = 0 iff v is non-decreasing — two lines, checked on 4,000 random vectors with no exception either way. It is the converse of §2.3 restricted to function graphs, derived from three instances before being recognised as something the book already held (register 303, search-before-deriving failing inward).

nodes.label: No genomic index in use is closed, and closure destroys the label's meaning
nodes.rationale: Three measurements triangulate a fourth point: genomic labels are assigned by discovery order, physical position or construction order, never by capacity, and closure requires labelling by capacity. A genomic coordinate carries where to look; the closed relabelling carries how much is there. The fullest closed definition exists, is unique, and is the one nothing can be looked up in.

nodes.label: Three prediction budgets, and only the ignorance budget cashed
nodes.rationale: E partitions by the modality of the admitted cell — coordinate 2,886,684,296 (forbidden), ignorance 150,630,700 (unknown), contingent 9,264,809,496 (realisable). The coordinate budget buys only falsehoods; the contingent budget cannot close without every human carrying the same genome; only the ignorance budget was ever a prediction, and it is 1.2 per cent of the total.

nodes.label: The snarl tower: the first non-trivial zero outside physics
nodes.rationale: Two haplotypes differing inside a child snarl differ inside its parent, so A(child) <= A(parent); read by height rather than level, A is non-decreasing and the index closes. 626 cells in a box of 2,726 at density 0.2296, E = 0 by height against 2,100 by level. The zero is strong because the density is not 1.0, and the result is orientation-dependent and data-independent — five of six committed predictions were refuted and the sixth carried it.

nodes.label: Register 302 — a test must be capable of failing for the claim it is offered against
nodes.rationale: A +/-10% perturbation found non-closure in 2,000 of 2,000 and the three-inversion count was then stated as though covered. Re-run at +/-3%, the inversion set reproduces only 269 times with counts from two to nine: non-closure is structural, the three is a fact about exact GRCh38 values. The first test measured the wrong claim and the second caught it.

nodes.label: Audit 9 DISTINCTNESS must run before audit 1 LATTICE
nodes.rationale: The same genetic difference can reappear at several levels of the snarl hierarchy; modelled at 5, 10 and 20 per cent duplication, 626 reported cells become 595, 564 and 501 distinct, so E would be computed on the wrong set. The audit ordering was fixed before this case arrived to test it, which is the only reason it holds here.

nodes.label: Search-before-deriving ledger for §24.4
nodes.rationale: Three of four components were already in print or already in this book and the protocol was followed on one of them: the Boolean-lattice genetic code, E = 3N as the variant space, the snarl/ultrabubble decomposition, and the monotonicity lemma. Provenance is stated too — GRCh38 lengths are recalled not retrieved, the A vector is synthetic and marked, no genome or graph file was fetched.
